name: skeleton
title: Skeleton
description: Loading placeholders where one soft, 20°-angled light band sweeps the whole screen as a single wave (or blocks brighten top-to-bottom, or gently pulse), all from one shared native-driver clock and static under reduce motion. Text, avatar, media, list, feed card and full-screen Nav composites, plus Skeleton.Reveal: the skeleton dissolves, content rises in child by child and the height glides between the two.
props: Block width and height, in points or percent.

Angled light band sweeping all blocks as one wave, a staggered top-to-bottom brighten, an opacity pulse, or no motion. Every variant is static when reduce motion is on.
